transcript: Speaker A (AI): Bade shahar ke customers se ghabra gaye kya? [Did you get scared of big-city customers?] Speaker B (Shopkeeper): Haan yaar, customer ne aisi heavy English jhaadi ki mere tote hi ud gaye. [Yes, friend, the customer spoke such heavy English that I was completely shocked.] Speaker A: Tote mat udao. SpeakEasy app pe aao aur mere saath bindass English bolo. [Don't be shocked. Come to the SpeakEasy app and speak English fearlessly with me.] Speaker B: Are madam, apni English toh ekdam zero hai. Kahan customer se pange loon? [Oh madam, my English is absolutely zero. How can I mess with customers?] Speaker A: Pange lo. Main AI tutor hoon. Tumhari aadhi-adhuri English bhi Hindi mein aaraam se theek karoongi. [Go ahead and mess with them. I am an AI tutor. I will easily correct your broken English in Hindi.] Speaker B: Baat toh sahi hai, par is bhaari dukaan ki bheed mein lambi classes ka waqt kahan hai? [That's true, but in the crowd of this busy shop, where is the time for long classes?] Speaker A: Kisne bola lambi class? Din ke sirf 15 minute baat karo aur trial bhi sirf ’1 mein. [Who said long classes? Just speak for 15 minutes a day, and the trial is for just ’1.] Speaker B: ’1 mein? Phir toh agli baar gore customer ko bhi poore tashan se saaman bechoonga. [For ’1? Then next time I will sell goods to even foreign customers with full style.] Speaker A: Done! Apni dukaan ko ek brand banao. SpeakEasy app turant download karo. [Done! Make your shop a brand. Download the SpeakEasy app immediately.] Speaker B: Bilkul, apna dhandha aur swag dono badhaane ke liye main abhi install karta hoon. [Absolutely, to increase both my business and swag, I will install it right now.] Speaker C (Presenter): Abhi SpeakEasy app download karein aur farratedar English bolna shuru karein. [Download the SpeakEasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
on_screen_text: Bade Shahar Ke Customers Se Ghabra Gye Kya? [Did you get scared of big-city customers?] SpeakEasy App [SpeakEasy App] Trial Bhi Sirf ’1 Mein [’1 Trial] Speak English Easily with SpeakEasy AI [Speak English Easily with SpeakEasy AI] Install Now [Install Now]
summary: A shopkeeper shares his fear of English-speaking customers with an AI tutor. The AI tutor introduces the SpeakEasy app, highlighting its 15-minute daily lessons and a ’1 trial to help him speak confidently. The ad concludes with a call to action to download the app and boost business.
